objective: Answer from official Claude Code documentation and changelog (code.claude.com/docs, the anthropics/claude-code CHANGELOG) the hook questions listed in the prompt, for Claude Code 2.1.300.
scope: Official Claude Code docs: hooks reference, plugins reference, changelog
constraints: Cite the URL and the quoted line for each answer; say 'not documented' when the docs are silent rather than inferring.
acceptance_criteria: Each numbered question has an answer with a citation, or 'not documented'.
result: Hook docs answers: Agent tool matchable; PostToolUse tool_response carries resolvedModel, totalTokens, totalDurationMs, totalToolUseCount, usage only for foreground calls; background launches return status, agentId, outputFile, resolvedModel. Forks are subagent_type fork via the Agent tool (PreToolUse visibility inferred). SubagentStop can block (reason becomes next instruction), input has agent_type, agent_id, agent_transcript_path, last_assistant_message. onFailure block from 2.1.295 blocks on can't-start/timeout, no effect on Stop/SubagentStop. CLAUDE_ENV_FILE works for main-session Bash; subagents not documented; PowerShell caveat. agent_type/agent_id present in subagent hook input.

acceptance.rationale: Each question answered with cited docs/changelog lines or marked not documented/inferred; limits disclosed.

criteria_evidence.Each numbered question has an answer wit: Seven answers with hooks/sub-agents page and changelog citations; fork PreToolUse and subagent CLAUDE_ENV_FILE marked inferred/not documented.
